title: Brazil - RJ - Rio de Janeiro: Tech Lead
description:
Overview

We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. You will be the technical anchor for a team of Senior Engineers handling:

  • Backend: Ingesting massive sensor streams and running multi-agent AI systems.
  • Data: Organizing tons of industrial data into a Medallion Architecture.
  • Frontend: Building the "Control Room" and complex AI interfaces.
  • DevOps: Deploying across hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure) and edge (K3s) environments.

Your challenge is to ensure these distinct pieces fit together, ensuring the backend model is consumable by the frontend’s "Visualizations" and that the "Data Pipelines" are reliably deployed by DevOps.

What You’ll Do

  • Technical Orchestration: You will drive cross-boundary architectural decisions. You will decide how the Backend serves live telemetry to Frontend dashboards and how Data Engineering pipelines feed the Knowledge Graph .
  • Code & Quality Standards: Enforce high standards across the stack. You will review API designs (FastAPI), ensure the Frontend maintains strict Component Architecture, and verify that Data pipelines implement appropriate quality gates.
  • The "Expert": When the DevOps engineer faces a connectivity issue between Cloud and On-Prem, or the Backend engineer struggles with concurrency in a distributed stream, you are the senior voice in the room, guiding the solution.
  • Team Leadership: Conduct code reviews, mentor senior developers, and translate high-level product requirements into technical tasks (ADO) for the squad.

Qualifications

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, with at least 2+ years leading technical teams.
  • Deep proficiency in Python Backend Development .
  • Solid understanding of Frontend complexity (SPA architecture, async data loading).
  • Experience designing or managing Data Intensive Applications (understanding ETL, Streams, or Data Lakes).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/Cloud concepts (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Good to Have:

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Experience with Digital Twins , IoT, or Industrial Data.
  • Experience with GenAI/LLM architecture (RAG, Agents).
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

The Technology Stack

You do not need to be an expert in every single tool, but you must be able to discuss technical trade-offs across the entire stack:

  • Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI), Kafka, Neo4j, LangGraph.
  • Frontend: Angular 16+, TypeScript, RxJS, Plotly.js.
  • Data: Apache Airflow, Delta Lake, Polars/Spark.
  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/K3s), Terraform, Hybrid Cloud

Desired Profile

  • The Architect-Implementer: You can draw the system architecture on a whiteboard, but you are not afraid to open an IDE to debug a failing pipeline or a slow query.
  • The Polyglot: You are likely a Backend or Full-Stack native, but you understand the complexity of Frontend state management (NgRx/Signals) and the constraints of Medallion Data Architectures.
  • Reliability Mindset: You understand that we are dealing with critical industrial environments. You prioritize testing, validation, and security.

title: Tech Talent Program 2026
description:
Viridien ( is an advanced technology, digital and Earth data company that pushes the boundaries of science for a more prosperous and sustainable future. With our ingenuity, drive and deep curiosity we discover new insights, innovations, and solutions that efficiently and responsibly resolve complex natural resource, digital, energy transition and infrastructure challenges.

Job Summary

We are looking for curious, analytical, and forward-thinking problem-solvers to join our Subsurface Imaging team at Viridien as part of our Tech Talent Program 2026 in a full-time position.

In this role, you will apply your knowledge of physics, mathematics, and technology to solve challenges across energy, infrastructure, and Earth data solutions. Working alongside industry experts, you will contribute to cutting-edge projects that redefine how we explore and understand the Earth’s subsurface.

To support your success, we provide structured onboarding, comprehensive technical training, and ongoing mentorship. You will learn how to transform raw seismic data into high-resolution 3D subsurface models, generating insights that support sustainable exploration and environmental stewardship.

Responsibilities

  • Apply advanced physics, mathematics, and geoscience principles to process and interpret seismic data.
  • Use state-of-the-art imaging techniques and high-performance computing (HPC) to tackle complex geophysical challenges.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to design and improve algorithms, tools, and workflows.
  • Work closely with Research and Software Development teams to help shape next-generation technologies.
  • Contribute to scientific publications, present findings, and support innovation across the organization and the wider geophysical community.

About the Team

You will join a supportive and collaborative team working on real-world geophysical challenges.

Our culture is driven by science, sparked by collaboration, and propelled by ambition — pillars that reflect what makes working at Viridien unique and exciting. They shape how we learn from each other, tackle complex problems, and grow together in an environment that encourages curiosity, teamwork, and continuous development from day one.

Qualifications

  • A PhD or Master’s degree in Geophysics, Physics, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.
  • Strong analytical, mathematical, and problem-solving skills.
  • A collaborative mindset, curiosity, and a genuine interest in innovation and continuous learning.

Benefits

At Viridien, we support both your professional growth and personal well-being:

  • Competitive salary with performance-based bonus.
  • Relocation package (when applicable).
  • Comprehensive health and dental insurance.
  • Private pension plan.
  • Meal voucher.
  • Free breakfast and snacks at the office.
  • Shiatsu therapy available on site.
  • TotalPass fitness program.
  • Hybrid work model (up to 2 remote days per week).
  • Birthday day off.
  • Christmas gift card.
  • Educational assistance and language learning programs.
  • Continuous development through our Learning Hub, offering both technical and behavioral training.

Our Hiring Process

At Viridien, we are committed to delivering a respectful, inclusive, and transparent recruitment experience.

Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we may not be able to provide individual feedback to every applicant. Only candidates whose qualifications closely match the role criteria will be contacted for an interview. We do, however, aim to share personalized feedback with those who progress to the first round of interviews and beyond.

We are also dedicated to ensuring that our hiring process accessible to all. If you require any reasonable adjustments to fully participate in the application or interview stages, please don’t hesitate to contact your recruiter directly.

We see things differently. Diversity fuels our innovation, we value the unique ways in which we differ, and we are committed to equal employment opportunities for all professionals.

title: Brazil - Remote: Data Engineer - Platform & Pipelines
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We are implementing a strict Medallion Architecture to organize petabytes of industrial data. This role is for a Data Engineer who excels at transforming raw chaos into structured, queryable assets.

You will build and maintain the ELT pipelines that move data from "Bronze" (Raw) to "Silver" (Cleaned) and "Gold" (Aggregated). You will work with Delta Lake (On-prem/Databricks ), Polars and Airflow to ensure data quality and availability for Data Scientists and the Knowledge Graph.

  • Pipeline Development: Develop and maintain robust Airflow DAGs to orchestrate complex data transformations.
  • Data Transformation: Use Spark (when scale requires) and Polars to clean, enrich, and aggregate data according to business logic.
  • Architecture Implementation: Enforce the Medallion Architecture patterns, ensuring clear separation of concerns between data layers.
  • Performance Tuning: Optimize processing workflows (Polars/Spark) jobs and SQL queries to reduce costs and execution time; make intelligent decisions on when to use Polars vs. Spark.
  • Deployment & Operations: Manage code deployment to on-prem and cloud infrastructure, including containerization and environment configuration.
  • Data Quality: Implement comprehensive data validation checks and quality gates between medallion layers.
  • Data Cataloging: Maintain the metadata and catalog entries to ensure all data assets are discoverable and documented.

The Technology Stack

  • Orchestration: Apache Airflow.
  • Data Processing: Polars (primary for ETL), PySpark/SQL (for massive scale)
  • Compute: Single-node workers (Polars), Databricks/Spark clusters (when scale requires)
  • Storage: Delta Lake, Parquet, S3/Blob Storage, MinIO
  • Language: Python 3.12+ (w/ Polars), SQL.

Qualifications

  • The Structured Thinker: You love organizing data. You understand the importance of schemas, data typing, and normalization.
  • Quality Obsessive: You don\'t just move data; you test it. You implement checks to ensure no bad data reaches the Gold layer.
  • Pipeline Builder: You view data engineering as software engineering. You write modular, reusable code for your transformations.

Must Haves

  • Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
    • Complete Bachelor\'s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
    • 3+ years of experience in Data Engineering.
    • Strong proficiency in Apache Airflow and Databricks.
    • Experience implementing Medallion/Delta Lake architectures.
    • Strong SQL and Python skills.
    • Advanced English communication skills.

Good To Have

  • Experience with Unity Catalog or other governance tools.
  • Familiarity with dbt (data build tool).
  • Background in processing telemetry or sensor data.

description:
1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider dedicated to empowering enterprises worldwide to unlock the full growth potential of mobile connectivity. Serving the world’s leading banks, corporations, and digital-first businesses—including neo-banks, travel companies, and payment service providers—1GLOBAL connects over 43 million devices globally.

With 2024 full-year revenue exceeding US$100 million and in line to exceed US$200 million in FY25, 1GLOBAL is a profitable business generating significant cash flows to fund its ongoing investments in infrastructure, transformation, and growth. 2024 saw major client wins and marked 1GLOBAL’s evolution from a multi-market telecommunication provider to a global technology-driven mobile connectivity powerhouse.

Established in 2022 by experienced tech founders and entrepreneurs Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL is a European technology leader driving digital transformation in the global telecommunications market. It operates as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator (“MVNO”) in ten countries and as a regulated telecommunications operator in an additional 31 countries. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world‑class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 450 experts across 15 countries.

Position Overview

1Global is seeking a talented and detail-oriented RoamingIREG Engineer to manage the entire roaming process and procedures. As an IREG Engineer you will be responsible for the technical setup, testing, and maintenance of international roaming and interconnect services.

We’re looking for a proactive individual with a strong technical foundation, adept at troubleshooting support cases and enhancing operational processes for seamless footprint updates.

This is a Lisbon‑based position, and relocation will be required. Relocation support may be provided for the selected candidate.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, execute, and document IREG tests (IR.24, IR.35, IR.50, etc.) for voice, SMS, and data services, in line with GSMA standards.
  • Set up and verify interconnect links for voice and messaging services with partner operators.
  • Monitor roaming service KPIs, troubleshoot issues, and ensure compliance with roaming agreements.
  • Configure and test SS7, Diameter, SIP, and related signaling protocols for international connectivity.
  • Liaise with foreign operators, roaming hubs, and internal teams during implementation and troubleshooting.
  • Maintain up‑to‑date test results, network configurations, and operational procedures.
  • Oversee the footprint management of all 1Global products, working closely with the wholesale and other networks team.

Must Have

  • Perform end‑to‑end roaming testing (voice, SMS, data, CAMEL, VoLTE, 5G roaming).
  • Execute IREG test cases according to GSMA guidelines and bilateral agreements.
  • Analyze and troubleshoot roaming issues with signaling traces and logs.
  • Work closely with international roaming partners to resolve interconnect problems.
  • Manage and update roaming documentation (IR.21).
  • Support new roaming launches (testing and activation of new operators, technologies, and services).
  • Coordinate with internal teams (Core Network, Billing, etc.) during testing and troubleshooting.
  • Validate TAP files and charging/billing aspects of roaming services.
  • Monitor KPIs and performance of roaming services after launch.
  • Follow‑up and define Quality and Performance indicators for the entire roaming service.
  • Close relationship with external partners like carriers, service providers.
  • Have successful partnerships with other departments and teams.

Qualifications

  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience
  • Knowledge of 3GPP, ETSI, standards and specifications for SIM/eSIM
  • Knowledge and experience with protocols such as MAP, S6a
  • Familiar with an RSP architecture and experience operating it
  • Knowledge in scripting and have basic programming skills.
  • Experience with protocol analyzer tools like Wireshark, Astelia, and ability to use them to troubleshoot networks errors/problems for the mentioned protocols
  • Experience with ETSI NFV architecture and solutions
  • Familiar with MVNO/MVNE/MVNA architecture(s) and landscape

What we offer?

  • CLT contract — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work
  • Quarterly performance bonuses to reward your hard work and achievements
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company
  • Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old — R$500 per month per child
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)!

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver’s seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals.
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast‑paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting‑edge field.
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company.
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment.
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results‑driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry.

1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

title: Legacy Manager
description:
Legacy Manager

Department:ostic Strategy & Planning

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that, for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting to Executive Director of Legacy and Stakeholder Affairs, the FWWC2027 Legacy Manager, under the guidance of the Executive Director of Legacy and Stakeholder Affairs, will oversee all matters related to the development, implementation and reporting of the FWWC 2027 Legacy Programme in close collaboration and with strategic guidance from the Women’s Football Division in FIFA.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Oversee and implement the FWWC 2027 Legacy Programme with theOURCES with all relevant stakeholders a coordinated, long‑lasting and tangible impact on the host country and region after hosting the event.
  • Coordinate the legacy activities of the CBF, FIFA and any other stakeholders related to the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027.(target>
  • Bring to life the FWWC 2027 legacy framework consisting of three core pillars:
    1. Women’s Football Legacy: work with CBF, host cities and relevant stakeholders to build a positive legacy on the women’s football landscape in Brazil and the region.
    2. Social Impact Legacy: work with CBF, the Brazilian Federal Government, State Governments, NGO’s and other relevant stakeholders to identify, build and implement a lasting social impact leveraging the FWWC 2027 with a particular focus on gender‑based violence and improving моделей of women in Brazilian society.
    3. Infrastructure Legacy: work with relevant stakeholders to develop, record and report on infrastructure legacy opportunities and projects that have arisen due to hosting of the FWWC 2027.
  • Prepare and finalise a report to be released post‑tournament which outlines the tangible impacts of the FWWC Legacy Programme including measures of both qualitative and quantitative impact.
  • Support the Women’s Football Division on any other matters related to the FWWC 2027 Legacy programme as and when required.

YOUR PROFILE

Experience in Major Sports Events and Brazilian based organisations:
  • Experience in a similar role within a Brazilian based organisation, with a clear track record of developing and implementing Legacy programmes and activities linked to major sporting events.
  • Proven track record of working in women’s football in Brazil (and the wider Region) with clear links and networks to key women’s football stakeholders.
Legacy Development
  • Proven track record of developing and implementing legacy strategies.
  • Experience in Project Management including planning, organising, and delivering complex projects and campaigns.
  • Experience in delivering post‑event reporting.
Communication & Stakeholder Relations
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to liaise with high‑level stakeholders, including government officials, commercial partners and media (when necessary).
  • Experience in managing relationships with diverse international stakeholders, including commercial partners, local authorities, and FIFA officials.
Cultural Competency & Multinational Experience
  • Experience working in multinational environments and understanding cultural nuances when coordinating across countries.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese (Brazilian).
  • Right to work in Brazil and ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Manager, Volunteer System
description:
Manager, Volunteer System

Department: Events & Entertainment

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting to the Senior Volunteer Manager – FIFA27, the Volunteer System Manager will play a key role in shaping and managing the volunteer journey through the FIFA Volunteer Platform, supporting operations across eight Host Cities within the Integrated Model.

The purpose of this role is to lead the set‑up, operation, and maintenance of the FIFA Volunteer Platform, which serves as the foundation for the entire volunteer experience. The successful candidate will also oversee essential system integrations to ensure a seamless, efficient, and high‑quality operational process for the tournament. This role will work in close collaboration with the Volunteer Management Teams at FIFA Zurich, FIFA27, Host Cities in Brazil and the FIFA Volunteer Platform provider, as well as with other Functional Areas, to ensure the technology platforms meet all operational requirements while supporting the successful delivery of the Volunteer Programme.

We are seeking an innovative and experienced systems professional with a proven record in managing complex, large‑scale event operations. The ideal candidate will join a dynamic, multicultural environment and bring both strategic insight and firsthand expertise to one of the most exciting sporting events in the world.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Work on development of all system processes in the FIFA volunteer platform, from application through to tournament‑time management, including test events and satellite events
  • Participate in the planning phase to finalise configuration of the FIFA Volunteer Platform ensuring it fully supports the requirements of the Integrated Model for a consistent volunteer experience and operational processes across all Host Cities.
  • Support the review and refine system functionalities to meet the evolving needs of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.
  • Ensure operational readiness to test and finalise the application form for the Volunteer Programme launch.
  • Ensure integration with other FIFA and local systems, managing all dependencies.
  • Act as the volunteer department’s main point of contact for User Access, User Validation, UAT (User Acceptance Testing), and system simulations.
  • Identify and propose technical solutions to operational challenges not addressed by existing functionality.
  • Ensure data integrity, compliance, and security across all volunteer systems in‑line with FIFA’s data protection standards.
  • Act as the first point of escalation and resolution for volunteer system issues.
  • Promote best practices in data management, analytics, and system governance.
  • Lead the creation of data reports, dashboards, and analytical tools for operational insights and decision‑making.
  • Monitor and report on project timelines, change requests, and system risks in line with the integrated volunteer systems plan.
  • Establish clear reporting and monitoring processes to evaluate programme effectiveness, volunteer satisfaction, and service delivery.
  • Lead the preparation and delivery of training materials and conduct “Train‑The‑Trainer” sessions for system users.
  • Ensure compliance to the FIFA tournament guidelines and oversee project execution in alignment with the approved budget, identifying efficiencies and cost‑effective delivery methods.
  • Contribute to the development and implementation of an International Volunteer Welcome Strategy, including logistics, visa facilitation, and cultural integration.
  • Ensure a structured systems close‑out process, including comprehensive handover and debrief report.
  • Represent the Volunteer team in cross‑functional area meetings, host city briefings, readiness workshops, stakeholder engagements, and strategic planning.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in large‑scale volunteer, workforce, or sport event programme management.
  • Education: Master’s in Sports Management or Event Management or Technology, Information Systems, or Project Management preferred.
  • Proven experience managing large‑scale technology or systems implementation projects.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and project management skills.
  • Strong analytical and reporting skills, including proficiency with data visualisation and business intelligence tools.
  • High cultural awareness with experience in multi‑stakeholder and multicultural environments.
  • Training delivery experience a plus
  • Familiarity with volunteer management systems (Rosterfy) and related IT tools is highly desirable.
  • Ability to be flexible and adopt an innovative mindset
  • Team player with internal and external stakeholders
  • Ability to thrive in an international, dynamic, and fast‑paced environment.
  • Collaborative and empathetic team player, passionate about community‑building, sport, and service.
  • Creativity and resourcefulness to enhance the volunteer experience and drive engagement.
  • Anticipates needs, understands the strategic impact of systems, and drives continuous improvement.
  • Project management or Systems Management certification is desired
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

  • Produce data‑driven reports to inform and influence HR initiatives.

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. title: Sales Manager
description:
Location: Rio De Janeiro, Brazil (Hybrid or Remote)

Cambly is one of the largest online English language platforms in the world, backed by top-tier investors like Bessemer and Benchmark. We help thousands of people improve their English and proudly partner with hundreds of the world’s most prestigious companies to empower their teams with language skills for global success.

We're looking for a highly motivated, organized, and results-driven Sales Manager.

Why Join Cambly?

Your experience at Cambly will be a true career accelerator where you'll gain crucial skills and build an invaluable network.

  • High-Impact Role: You'll be tackling a critical challenge for Learning & Development teams making a tangible difference in organizational success.

  • Career Growth: Work directly with experienced sales leaders and utilize the latest sales technology.

  • Premium Network: Build relationships and network with prestigious HR and procurement teams across the Turkish market.

  • Culture: An employee-first working culture focused on results, no unnecessary stress or nonsense.

The Role

The Sales Manager is a high-impact role responsible for driving significant sales growth by penetrating and securing business with the accounts in our target market. You are responsible for defining and executing a strategic account plan to drive massive revenue growth. This involves navigating large organizational structures, establishing rapport with executive decision-makers, and aligning internal resources to deliver customized solutions. You must be adept at negotiating enterprise level agreements and driving momentum throughout the lengthy sales cycle.

Responsibilities

  • Strategic Account Ownership: Fully own a targeted list of strategic accounts, developing and executing comprehensive inbound and outbound strategies

  • Full Sales Cycle Management: Take complete ownership and accountability for the entire sales process, from the initial qualification (post-lead generation) through negotiation, contract signing, and deal closure

  • Team Management: Directly manage and coach at least 2 teammates, ensuring high performance, pipeline contribution, and adherence to outbound metrics

  • Revenue Achievement: Consistently meet or exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue targets.

  • Pipeline Generation: Proactively cultivate a robust sales pipeline through expert individual outreach, collaborative campaigns with your SDR, and efficient management of qualified inbound prospects.

  • Relationship & Rapid Closure: Efficiently build and nurture relationships with business owners and key decision-makers (often learning and development managers, or department heads) within the small business segment. Drive swift internal buy-in and successfully negotiate and close transactions quickly, maintaining a high volume of closed deals.

  • Business Acumen & Insight: Possess the rapid instincts necessary to quickly assess a small business's current needs, financial capacity, and decision-maker motivations , leveraging this insight to position our solution for an efficient win.

  • Data Integrity & Forecasting: Maintain impeccable data quality in our CRM with up-to-date customer information, accurate forecasts, and precise pipeline data to ensure optimal business visibility and continuous sales process improvement.

Qualifications

Must-Haves

  • Native in Portuguese and fully proficient in English (C1/C2 level) for clear business communication.

  • 5+ years of total B2B sales experience, with at least 1+ year of proven success in lead generation

  • A demonstrable track record of developing greenfield territories and landing net-new logos both in SMB and Enterprise companies.

  • Demonstrated ability to build, maintain, and leverage relationships with senior line-of-business and C-level executives.

  • Possess a true Hunter mentality with solid sales DNA, a proactive entrepreneurial spirit, and an appetite for continual learning within a fast-paced startup environment.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience engaging with HR & Learning Development teams.

  • Prior sales experience in the learning, e-learning, HR software, or well-being industry.

  • Prior experience working at a fast-growing startup .

  • Previous experience working in a remote & distributed team .

  • Professional working proficiency in Spanish

Skills & Mindset

  • A self-motivated, results-driven, and entrepreneurial spirit with a strong growth mindset.

  • Strong organizational and time management skills ; ability to work autonomously and self-source solutions.

  • Active relationship builder who can collaborate effectively with internal and external teams to consistently improve processes and communication.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic, and remote team environment .

Some things you will enjoy

  • Financial & Growth: Competitive salary, a fair commission system, and a professional development budget.

  • Health & Well-being: Comprehensive medical and dental insurance coverage. We also provide Life Insurance for added security.

  • Mental Health: Access to Modern Health, offering 6 free coaching and 6 free therapy sessions.

  • Flexibility & Time Off & Rest: Hybrid work. 30 calendar days of mandatory paid time off (eligible after 12 months), ensuring you take the necessary time to recharge.

  • Daily Comfort: Meal voucher (via Flash Card) for daily sustenance

  • Growth & Culture: An employee-first working culture focused on results and growth, no unnecessary stress or nonsense.

  • Team: A truly global team.

  • Language Benefit: Free access to Cambly so you can improve your language skills.

IMPORTANT APPLICATION NOTE

Your application will not be evaluated unless you provide a detailed answer to the question: “Why do you want to work at Cambly?”

Treat this as your initial sales pitch: Be creative, honest, and compelling!

title: Program Manager, Grantee Experience (Independent Contractor)
description:
Program Manager, Grantee Experience - Independent Contractor

Scope of Services

This is an independent contractor engagement, not an employment role. The successful contractor will provide services under a defined scope and will not be engaged as an employee.

1. Project Overview

Tilt Collective is engaging an independent contractor to provide program and grantee engagement support to strengthen relationships with partners and grantees across key portfolios. The engagement will initially focus on Brazil and US grant making, with additional support across Tilt Collective’s countries and programs as required.

The Contractor will provide specialist support to enhance program implementation, strengthen compliance processes, and improve communication between Tilt Collective and its organizational partners. The Contractor will operate independently, using their own professional expertise and judgement, while collaborating with Tilt Collective stakeholders as needed to deliver the agreed services.

2. Scope of Services and Deliverables

The Contractor will provide the following services. Percentages indicate anticipated focus and do not guarantee a minimum or maximum time allocation.

A. Partner relationship management and communication (approximately 40%)

  • Act as an additional point of contact for routine partner and grantee communications, as agreed with Tilt Collective
  • Facilitate structured check-ins with partner grantees, in coordination with relevant Program Staff, to support progress tracking and issue identification
  • Coordinate translation support and cross-cultural communication requirements, particularly in Brazil
  • Support strategic communications between Tilt Collective and grantee partners Provide input and recommendations to help maintain productive partner relationships aligned with program objectives

B. Grant making process support (approximately 40%)

  • Support the adaptation and localisation of grant making policies, processes, and documentation to improve accessibility and contextual relevance, particularly for Brazil
  • Draft and contribute to internal grant making documents, including nomination forms and investment memos
  • Review grant proposals and provide written assessments against agreed strategic and program criteria
  • Support compliance and due diligence processes by preparing documentation and inputs as requested by the Grants Team
  • Contribute recommendations to improve grantmaking tools, procedures, and documentation

C. Additional grantee engagement and learning support (approximately 20%)

  • Support the implementation and use of MEAL tracking tools to monitor grantee progress and outcomes
  • Contribute to the preparation of progress updates and summary reports for internal or external use
  • Identify themes, trends, and learning points across grantee engagement and share insights with Tilt Collective stakeholders

3. Term and Time Commitment

The anticipated start date is as soon as reasonably practicable, with an expected commencement by Q1 2026.

The engagement is expected to average up to 20 hours per week for planning purposes. Tilt Collective guarantees a minimum commitment of 15 hours per week for the first six months of the engagement.

Hours above this level may be required by mutual agreement and in line with agreed deliverables and timelines. The Contractor retains discretion over how and when the services are performed, subject to meeting those deliverables and timelines.

4. Collaboration and Communications

The Contractor will work primarily with the Grants Director, who will serve as the primary point of contact. Regular touchpoints may be scheduled to align on priorities, deliverables, and timelines. These touchpoints are intended for coordination and information sharing and do not create a reporting or supervisory relationship.

5. Performance and Deliverables

Successful delivery will be assessed based on the quality, timeliness, and completeness of agreed outputs, including but not limited to:

  • Grant making documents produced
  • Proposal reviews and written assessments completed
  • Partner and grantee engagement activities delivered
  • Contributions to process improvement and learning

Feedback from relevant stakeholders, including the Grants Team and Program or Country leadership, may be used to inform the overall assessment of the services delivered.

6. Fees and Payment

Fees will be paid monthly following submission of an invoice detailing services provided during the applicable period, in accordance with the agreed contract terms. Finance will confirm final payment mechanics separately.

Contractor Skills/ Requirements

  • Necessity for fluency in Brazilian Portuguese and English
  • Location in Brazil, USA, or a similar time zone
  • Ability to commit for six months

title: FF&E Supply chain Manager
description:
This position will work closely with Interior Designers and Senior FF&E Procurement Manager to maintain FF&E budgets, project procurement, supply chain, logistics and project installations.

We are seeking a highly organized and experienced FF&E Supply Chain Project Manager to oversee the full logistics, quality control, and delivery process for a luxury residential hospitality project in Brazil. This role is responsible for managing production follow-up, factory coordination, inbound logistics from multiple regions (Brazil and Europe), storage operations in Preá, and final‑mile delivery into Jericoacoara—an area with challenging access conditions.

The ideal candidate has strong project management skills, experience in complex supply‑chain environments, and the ability to work collaboratively with vendors, factories, construction teams, installers, and logistics partners.

At a Glance:

  1. Mid–Senior role overseeing end‑to‑end FF&E supply chain for a luxury hospitality project in Brazil
  2. Responsible for factory supervision, quality control, and production sign‑off (Brazil & Europe)
  3. Manages storage operations in Preá and all inbound logistics
  4. Coordinates last‑mile delivery into Jericoacoara with specialized 4x4/off‑road vehicles
  5. Oversees inventory accuracy, documentation, dispatch & receiving
  6. Plans and supervises loading/unloading, equipment rental, and batch delivery scheduling
  7. Works closely with Construction for delivery timelines, site readiness, and installation planning
  8. Supervises Utopia‑hired installers to ensure deadlines, quality standards, and contractual commitments
  9. Must be highly organized, proactive, and experienced in complex or remote logistics environments

Responsibilities

Production Oversight & Quality Control

  • Supervise FF&E production at each factory (Brazil & Europe).
  • Conduct detailed quality checks and approve inventory before packing and sign‑off.
  • Ensure all items meet Utopia’s standards for quality, specifications, and finishes.

Inbound Logistics & Storage Management

  • Monitor and confirm the arrival of goods at the Preá storage facility.
  • Arrange and oversee loading/unloading operations at all locations.
  • Hire necessary local equipment or machinery as required.
  • Maintain a full, accurate, and continuously updated inventory of all items.

Documentation & Compliance

  • Handle all dispatch, receiving, and transport paperwork.
  • Ensure complete documentation for internal controls and auditing.

Delivery Coordination & Final‑Mile Logistics

  • Oversee delivery schedules from factories to Preá, ensuring timely arrivals.
  • Plan and manage logistics from Preá to Jericoacoara—including batch deliveries due to access restrictions (large trucks cannot cross dunes).
  • Hire and coordinate appropriate 4x4 or off‑road trucks capable of operating in sandy conditions.
  • Supervise all loading/unloading operations for the Preá–Jericoacoara transfers.

On‑Site Coordination & Installation Support

  • Coordinate delivery timelines and equipment needs with the Construction team.
  • Organize and supervise unpacking activities.
  • Oversee Utopia‑hired installation teams to ensure full compliance with contract requirements, deadlines, and quality standards.

Professional Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in FF&E logistics, supply chain management, project management, or procurement—preferably in hospitality or high‑end residential projects.
  • Proven experience supervising factory production, performing quality checks, and managing sign‑off processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate international and domestic logistics (Brazil + Europe preferred).
  • Experience managing storage facilities, inventory systems, and warehouse operations.
  • Solid track record overseeing loading/unloading operations, equipment rental, and transport coordination.
  • Hands‑on experience with remote or difficult‑access job sites (desert, beach, island, jungle environments are a strong plus).
  • Experience coordinating with construction teams, installers, and multiple vendors simultaneously.
  • Prior responsibility for delivery scheduling, documentation, and compliance.
  • Experience supervising installation teams is highly desirable.
  • Portuguese and English a must - any other language a plus.

Technical Skills

  • Strong knowledge of FF&E manufacturing processes, materials, finishes, and quality standards.
  • Proficiency in inventory management tools, tracking systems, and documentation workflows.
  • Understanding of logistics planning, especially final‑mile or off‑road delivery constraints.
  • Familiarity with transport regulations, customs basics, and dispatch/receiving procedures.
  • Strong reporting and documentation skills (photos, checklists, receiving logs, QC reports).
  • Ability to read technical documents (spec sheets, shop drawings, BOQs).

Salary and benefits are competitive and based on candidate experience.

Note: Please submit your CV in English.

A equipe da Amazon Logistics Brasil (AMZL) está procurando por um/uma Analista de Operações Logísticas para se juntar ao time de gestão e monitoramento de coletas de sellers. O/A Analista de Transporte - First Mile atua em uma escala 5x2 em revezamento de turnos. É responsável por monitorar o desempenho e a conformidade dos transportadores da operação de coleta (inbound), em coordenação com times internos e externos. O trabalho exige alguém com capacidade de assumir responsabilidades, identificar padrões e tendências, explorar detalhes e analisar dados, aprofundando-se nas causas raízes dos problemas operacionais e propondo soluções. As operações serão feitas 7 dias por semana, incluindo feriados; trabalhar em diferentes turnos será parte desta função.

  • Gerir problemas diários junto aos transportadores de forma colaborativa e construtiva, identificar oportunidades de melhoria no processo de ponta a ponta e identificar melhorias na área;

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Benefits

  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match

  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us! This information is provided for prospective applicants. Benefits details can be found at the university benefits site.

Job Purpose

The Building Manager ensures the smooth operation of teaching, research and office space, and acts as a liaison between the Chemistry Department, Department of Environmental Health and Safety (EHS), and Physical Facilities Management (PFM) team. The candidate must have a strong understanding of building systems and chemistry laboratories. The successful candidate will oversee and participate in needed maintenance and repairs of the building to ensure functional integrity for teaching and research.

Supervisory Authority

None.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include staff, students and faculty.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Serves as the main contact for the Chemistry Department for routine and emergency maintenance and repair requests.
  • Monitor the building condition (particularly the laboratory space) by performing regular inspections, and schedule routine maintenance (e.g., fume hoods, HVAC, and roof). Report maintenance or cleaning needs to the department staff.
  • Assist the department with submission of work orders to PFM as needed and monitor progress.
  • Oversee the work of vendors and contractors by maintaining standing orders and managing professional relationships; and provide building access to outside vendors and contractors.
  • Work closely with faculty and staff to provide solutions to facility-related problems.
  • Design, plan, or assist in renovation/modification projects to meet specific department or research needs or to correct building problems, requiring an understanding of structural design and department needs.
  • Respond to building emergencies, and serve as the primary emergency contact 24 hours a day throughout the year, including semester breaks, weekends, and holidays.
  • Assist faculty, staff and graduate students with shipping, receiving, and moving tasks.
  • Installation of some laboratory equipment, cabinetry, shelving, etc.
  • Communicate with the appropriate Facilities staff when the work order is not completed within a reasonable time frame.
  • Serve as a liaison to Public Safety, PFM, EHS, and other university entities in emergency response situations and for safety-related topics.
  • Supervision of small groups of student workers.

Laboratory Safety

  • Troubleshoot and advise on problems that arise regarding the safety of building or laboratory facilities.
  • Check safety showers and eyewash stations weekly to ensure their working conditions.
  • Remain up to date with University safety training.
  • Act as a department contact for Department of Environmental Health and Safety (EHS).
  • Understand hazardous material safety guidelines per University protocols.
  • Work with EHS on proper handling of hazardous waste materials from teaching and research laboratories.
  • Assist in chemical/solvent deliveries as necessary.
  • Develop and execute response plans for safety, security, and business continuity.

Perform other duties as assigned by the Chemistry Department.

Minimum Requirements

  • Five years of related experience in a variety of trades relevant to general building functions including carpentry, plumbing, electrical, HVAC, and mechanical; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Knowledge of building materials and methods.
  • Proven supervisory skills.
  • Abilities to use Microsoft Office suite, particularly Excel and Outlook.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, ability to work with faculty members, staff, and students.
  • Valid driver’s license (ability to drive University vehicles).
  • Ability to climb ladders, kneel, reach above the shoulder, stand and/or walk for extended periods of time and may be required to wear personal protective equipment (PPE).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in science, engineering, or related field.
  • Experience in specifying and purchasing parts or equipment.
  • Experience working in chemistry laboratory/research setting.
  • Understanding and minor maintenance of water purification systems, laboratory hoods, and electronic locksets.
  • Ability to engage, connect, and work with diverse student, administrative, and faculty populations and provide a commitment to the values of diversity, equity, and inclusion in an educational setting.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$65,000-$75,000

title: Metering Engineer
description:
This position will support FPSO operations by overseeing and ensuring the integrity of all metering systems. It will involve monitoring system performance, validating data, and providing daily operational support. The role will also act as the Technical Authority for metering, ensuring compliance with technical and regulatory requirements, including ANP and INMETRO standards.

Responsibilities

  • Responsible for ensuring that all fluid metering systems at FPSO are performed in accordance with the technical requirements and legal deadlines, meeting the requirements outlined in Joint Resolution ANP / INMETRO 01: 2013 (RTM).
  • Provide technical support daily, in relation to measurement problems in the FPSO.
  • Participate/assist in metering audits.
  • Act as Technical Authority to measurement issues.
  • Verify that FPSO operator’s procedures and manuals are in accordance with current ANP, ISO and other relevant standards for offshore oil and natural gas flow measurement (fiscal, allocation and operational).
  • Manage and monitor the status of the flow metering systems (fiscal, allocation and operational).
  • Conduct critical analysis of failure reports, calibrations and periodic maintenance of fiscal, allocation and custody transfer metering systems in accordance with RTM and applicable standards.
  • Verify, validate and submit data (failure reports, flow computer data, well test reports and monthly production report) related to the FPSO metering systems to ANP.
  • Keep updated the measurement points registered in the SFP (ANP production system).
  • Validate offloading measurement reports.
  • Verify the operational history of seal removal and installation.
  • Verify that the FPSO operator is following calibration plans, uncertainty calculations, and required flow computer upgrades.
  • Verify / validate in case of measurement system failure the volume estimate as specified in ANP resolutions.
  • Verify / monitor backups of measurement equipment information, fault history, equipment replacement, and parameter changes.
  • Carry out the planning and control of the sample collection service for chemical analysis, interface with logistics for loading / unloading materials related to the samples, and, if necessary, validate the results of PVT and chromatographic analysis. After validation, monitor the results/inform the need to update the flow computers.
  • Follow up the routines to keep the Metering Management System in operation without non-conformities.

Education

  • Bachelor's Degree in Automation, Petroleum, Production, Chemical Engineering or related.

Knowledge and Skills

  • Good understanding and knowledge of FPSO marine & process systems.
  • Familiar with engineering/industry standards such as API, ASME, ASTM, NACE etc.
  • Advanced English (oral and written).

O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 121 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes e que utilizam as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade máxima para mais de 95.000 alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio.

Nossas escolas Inspired estão em 27 países e cada uma é pensada individualmente de acordo com o contexto local e é ancorada na cultura vibrante na qual se encontra. Coletivamente, elas compõem uma comunidade que nutre o desenvolvimento acadêmico e pessoal dos alunos num ambiente de aprendizagem progressivo, dinâmico e inovador.

Se juntando ao nosso time de mais de 13.000 colaboradores, você poderá trabalhar em instalações de última geração ao lado de educadores e líderes renomados do setor em alguns dos lugares mais desejados do mundo. Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes e assim cada um consegue aproveitar desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o nosso grupo.

Sobre a vaga

A Escola Eleva é uma das escolas Inspired no Brasil. Aqui nós temos vocação para ensinar e paixão por aprender. Nosso time é movido por excelência, entusiasmo, respeito e responsabilidade. Somos adeptos da mentalidade de crescimento e estamos constantemente motivados a buscar o que há de melhor em educação, no Brasil e no mundo e em pensar as melhores maneiras de aplicar isso em nossas escolas e inspirar nossos alunos.

Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de líderes capazes de fazer a diferença em suas vidas e contribuir para um mundo melhor. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. Pessoas que superam desafios diariamente, com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.

Nesse papel você será responsável pelo suporte técnico prestado aos usuários, pela manutenção e implantação de equipamentos, programas e sistemas, e pelo planejamento e desempenho da área de TI na unidade. Deve solicitar orçamentos quando necessário, e providenciar a aquisição de equipamentos e licenças.

Responsabilidades

O que você fará

  • Gerenciamento de redes, servidores e ativos:
  • Manter os servidores;
  • Realizar a configuração e instalação de novos equipamentos de rede, assegurando que a documentação da rede esteja atualizada;
  • Monitorar redes, verificando logs e equipamentos físicos;
  • Realizar a inclusão, manutenção e exclusão de usuários no ambiente de rede corporativo;
  • Manter e atualizar a lista/inventário de ativos de TDIC da escola.

Suporte técnico

  • Fornecer apoio técnico aos alunos e colaboradores assegurando o diagnóstico e reparação de problemas técnicos em diversos equipamentos tecnológicos (laptops, projetores, sistemas de informação, servidores etc) de forma que todo o hardware e software funcione corretamente;
  • Preparar equipamentos de TI para utilização;
  • Executar procedimentos de rotina para checar de forma preventiva se equipamentos e soluções estão funcionando como previsto e esperado;
  • Prestar suporte e atendimento a telefonia móvel e VOIP da escola;
  • Manter contatos regulares com as equipes das escolas para verificar preventivamente se as soluções de tecnologia estão funcionando como esperado.

Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo.

Requisitos

  • Ensino superior completo na área de TI - Ciências da Computação, Análise de Sistemas, Rede de Computadores ou afins;
  • Experiência com suporte técnico de TI, sistemas operacionais clientes Windows (Windows server 2012 ou superior), Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, WSUS, File server, Print Server, ativos de rede (impressoras, scanners, WIFI);
  • Conhecimento básico para gerenciar regras de firewall;
  • Habilidades de instalação e configuração de hardware e software;
  • Inglês intermediário.

Será um diferencial se você tiver

  • Experiência em escolas ou projetos pedagógicos;
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura Meraki, Fortigate, Ubiquiti ou Mikrotik;
  • Certificação ITIL ou similar em redes de computadores ou projetos;
  • Conhecimento de métodos ágeis;
  • Inglês avançado.

Declaração de Salvaguarda

O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. Nascemos em 2017 com o propósito de Ser a Melhor Empresa de Saneamento PARA o Brasil. Hoje, estamos presentes em diversos municípios e estados brasileiros, com o objetivo de contribuir para que o país alcance a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto.

Nosso modelo de negócios consiste em concessões e parcerias público-privadas (PPPs). Somos uma das principais companhias de saneamento do país, inserida na vida de comunidades de diferentes portes e atendendo milhões de pessoas.

Na Iguá Saneamento valorizamos a diferença em todos os contextos e trabalhamos para promover uma cultura ética e inclusiva sempre. Venha fazer parte dessa mudança; acreditamos na força de cada individualidade para gerar transformação!

Informações adicionais

✨ Nossos Benefícios

Aqui, cuidamos das nossas pessoas em todas as etapas da sua jornada como colaborador. Conheça o que oferecemos:

Saúde, bem-estar e qualidade de vida

VENHA TRABALHAR COM A GENTE!

⚡Em 2017, nascemos com um propósito: ser a MELHOR empresa de saneamento PARA o Brasil. Job Overview

The Senior Project Controls Specialist uses best practices and knowledge of internal or external issues to improve the project controls discipline within McDermott. They will act as a resource for colleagues with less experience and share their conceptual and practical expertise related to the project controls discipline. The Senior Project Controls Specialist solves complex problems and uses their discipline‑specific knowledge to improve their products or services. Qualifications

Essential Qualifications and Education:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management or a related field
  • Minimum of five (5) years of relevant experience in Project Controls, Cost Engineering, or Financial Analysis within an EPC or project‑driven environment
  • Proficiency in general office productivity tools, particularly spreadsheets, word processing, and presentation software

Responsibilities

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Lead the development and deployment of advanced visual analytics to support project performance monitoring, forecasting, and executive‑level reporting
  • Apply data mining, statistical modeling, and trend analysis techniques to identify key performance indicators, cost drivers, and schedule risks across complex, multi‑phase projects
  • Integrate and link data from multiple internal and external sources to build robust, multi‑dimensional models that support real‑time decision‑making
  • Architect scalable data structures and implement standardized methods for data transformation, validation, and automation across project controls systems
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams—including engineering, procurement, construction, finance, and IT—to understand business needs and translate them into actionable data solutions
  • Interpret complex data requests and deliver clear, accurate, and insightful outputs that align with project and organizational objectives

  • Guide and mentor junior team members on data governance, reporting standards, and best practices for data management, storage, and security
  • Develop predictive models and forecasting tools based on historical data, current trends, and scenario planning to support long‑term project planning and risk mitigation
  • Support the implementation and continuous improvement of digital project controls tools and platforms, ensuring alignment with global EPC standards and practices
  • Lead or contribute to the development of internal training materials and knowledge‑sharing initiatives to elevate data literacy and project controls capabilities across the organization
  • Ensure compliance with internal controls, client requirements, and industry standards in all aspects of data handling and reporting.
  • Act as a subject matter expert in project data analytics, guiding Project Managers, Cost Engineers, and Executive Stakeholders on data‑driven decision‑making

title: Ubuntu Software Engineer
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring engineers to work across the breadth of our Ubuntu Engineering organisation - engineers who care deeply for quality, performance and resilience in software, engineers who are just as comfortable with designing and engineering new software as they are with packaging, integrating, testing and shipping the incredible catalog of open source software provided by the Ubuntu repositories.

Our engineers integrate the freshest open source software, provide robust upgrade paths and engineer the future of Ubuntu. Ubuntu is not just the world's most deployed open source operating system, it's a platform that enables innovation for millions of users across the globe. Our community represents the full breadth of the developer experience; from students, hobbyists and freelancers to high performance engineering and creative teams in corporate and academic environments.

Teams that ship Ubuntu

  • Foundations : maintaining foundational software: architectures, package managers, compilers, toolchains, bootloaders, filesystems and core utilities
  • Server : leading the design, evolution and future of our Ubuntu Server distribution
  • Desktop : driving Ubuntu Desktop, our future immutable desktop: Ubuntu Core Desktop, WSL, gaming technology, and a suite of modern applications for the desktop crafted with Flutter
  • Debcrafters : a new team responsible for the forward movement, maintenance and overall health of the Ubuntu archive: one of the most abundant repositories of open source software available today

Bring your existing expertise and learn new skills by working on one of the most prolific pieces of open source software. As an engineer working on Ubuntu you could work on any or all of the following categories:

  • Development : design, build and ship new foundational systems software and applications in Rust, Go, Flutter, and Python
  • Architecture : engineer the integration of open source from boot firmware to cloud applications deployment
  • Packaging : a combination of Debian and Snap packaging to ship software in the distribution
  • Automation : build and maintain the machinery responsible for building, testing and shipping Ubuntu
  • Distro Engineering : the maintenance and evolution of a Linux distribution and its repositories

This application track is suitable for those at the mid point in their career but perhaps not quite at the Manager/Lead level, with relevant skills to contribute to Ubuntu.

At Canonical, you will have the opportunity to engage with and contribute to the broader open source community. We're looking for individuals who can help build a thriving community and contribute with enthusiasm and precision to a broad range of technologies.

Location

We have remote roles open in every time zone.

The role entails

Based on the first round of interviews, we identify specific teams where you might be an excellent fit and conduct second-round interviews with those teams. Our engineers are:

  • Designing, building and shipping software in Rust, Go and Python

title: Brazil - Remote: Team Lead - Digital Twin Platform
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

You will be the technical anchor for a team of Senior Engineers handling:

  1. Backend: Ingesting massive sensor streams and running multi-agent AI systems.
  2. Data: Organizing tons of industrial data into a Medallion Architecture.
  3. Frontend: Building the “Control Room” and complex AI interfaces.
  4. DevOps: Deploying across hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure) and edge (K3s) environments.

Your challenge is to ensure these distinct pieces fit together. ensuring the backend model is consumable by the frontend’s “Visualizations” and that the “Data Pipelines” are reliably deployed by DevOps.

What You’ll Do

  • Technical Orchestration: You will drive cross-boundary architectural decisions. You will decide how the Backend serves live telemetry to Frontend dashboards and how Data Engineering pipelines feed the Knowledge Graph .
  • Code & Quality Standards: Enforce high standards across the stack. You will review API designs (FastAPI), ensure the Frontend maintains strict Component Architecture, and verify that Data pipelines implement appropriate quality gates.
  • The 'Expert' : When the DevOps engineer faces a connectivity issue between Cloud and On-Prem, or the Backend engineer struggles with concurrency in a distributed stream, you are the senior voice in the room, guiding the solution.
  • Team Leadership: Conduct code reviews, mentor senior developers, and translate high-level product requirements into technical tasks (ADO) for the squad.

The Technology Stack

You do not need to be an expert in every single tool, but you must be able to discuss technical trade-offs across the entire stack:

  • Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI), Kafka, Neo4j, LangGraph.
  • Frontend: Angular 16+, TypeScript, RxJS, Plotly.js.
  • Data: Apache Airflow, Delta Lake, Polars/Spark.
  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/K3s), Terraform, Hybrid Cloud

Qualifications

Must Haves:

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, with at least 2+ years leading technical teams.
  • Deep proficiency in Python Backend Development .
  • Solid understanding of Frontend complexity (SPA architecture, async data loading).
  • Experience designing or managing Data Intensive Applications (understanding ETL, Streams, or Data Lakes).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/Cloud concepts (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

Good to Have:

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Experience with Digital Twins , IoT, or Industrial Data.
  • Experience with GenAI/LLM architecture (RAG, Agents).
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

Desired Profile

  • The Architect-Implementer: You can draw the system architecture on a whiteboard, but you are not afraid to open an IDE to debug a failing pipeline or a slow query.
  • The Polyglot: You are likely a Backend or Full-Stack native, but you understand the complexity of Frontend state management (NgRx/Signals) and the constraints of Medallion Data Architectures.
  • Reliability Mindset: You understand that we are dealing with critical industrial environments. You prioritize testing, validation, and security.

The Venue Design Manager reports to FIFA27 Head of Infrastructure & Technical Services and FIFA Senior Venue Design Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team in close collaboration with the Venue Management team and other stakeholders.

The FIFA Women's World Cup 2027™ requires venue design of as a key central delivery to fully integrate and visually represent all operations, legacy information and complementary structures required for the tournament. The Venue Design Manager is responsible for leading and implementing the venue design from block planning through to final design across a cluster of official FIFA stadiums and venues.

Role to transition into onsite Venue Overlay Manager during final Event.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Raw Data Management

  • Reception, validation and conversion of raw data into clean base CADs

Application of FIFA Drawing Standards

  • Drawing updates according to FIFA standards and templates (layers, colour codes, line styles, annotation, legends, layouts, naming conventions etc.)

Drawing Updates

  • Integration of operational content (space allocation, perimeters, flow data, capacities, space tags), legacy information (base infrastructure, legacy usage/annotation/signage) and complementary structures (fences, commodities, FF&E layouts etc.) as required.

Application of BIM 360 Workflows

  • Management and interaction of central database for drawing development, communication, change requests and publications.

Implementation of Space Requirements

  • Application of requirements according to FIFA Event Platform (EP) and venue limitations.

Drawing Publications

  • Delivery of drawings sets according to inspections and project timelines (site plans, levels, seating maps, pitch plans, catwalks, sections, detailed layouts etc.)

Ongoing Collaboration

  • Continuous collaboration and support for Venue Management and FIFA Functional Areas.
  • Collaborate with the Technical Services and Overlay teams, Functional Areas, stadium authorities, and other stakeholders to define, optimize and validate solutions, ensuring technical requirements are accurately reflected in designs and BoQs.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Degree in architecture, engineering, urban planning or a related field.
  • Minimum 5 years’ experience managing multi-venue overlay projects, from design to delivery, preferably for major sporting events (e.g., FIFA, Olympic Games).
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD, BIM 360, Adobe Creative Cloud and Microsoft Office tools.
  • Strong technical knowledge in temporary infrastructure and spatial planning.
  • Excellent organisational, coordination, and communication skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Excellent drawing skills and attention to detail
  • Ability to work under pressure, manage competing priorities, and deliver to tight deadlines.
  • Knowledge of local construction regulations and permitting processes in host country (desirable).
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. We are looking for developers ready to tackle one (or more) of those challenges:

  • Ingestion: Handling massive streams of sensor data with minimal latency.
  • Intelligence: Making LLMs deterministic and reliable within robust multi-agent systems.

You will join a high-performance team, contributing to the Core Backend while focusing on one of the following distinct tracks:

Core Responsibilities

  • Rapid Delivery: Adopt a 'deliver fast' mentality without compromising on code quality, testing, or API design standards.

Possible paths to work on the Project (you can contribute to one or more):

Streaming & High-Throughput Data

  • Build Streaming Pipelines: Design scalable services using Kafka and Spark/Flink to process raw sensor data in real-time.

GenAI & Autonomous Agents

  • Build Autonomous Agents: Deploy stateful agents (using LangGraph) that plan tasks, query Knowledge Graphs, and execute tools without hallucinating.
  • Advanced RAG: Build Graph-RAG pipelines that combine semantic search with structured knowledge traversal for grounded answers

Graph & Knowledge Engineering

  • Knowledge Graph Engineering: Design domain ontologies in Neo4j, defining relationships between assets, documents, and time-series data.
  • Search Infrastructure: Implement Hybrid Retrieval logic combining Vector Search, Full-Text Search, and Graph traversal.

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.

  • Computer Science fundamentals: Data Structures and Algorithms.

Good to Have:

  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

We use a modern, high-performance stack. You should be proficient in the Core and deeply knowledgeable in your chosen track.

  • Core Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI, Pydantic), Polars, Docker, Kubernetes.
  • Streaming: Apache Kafka, Flink, Spark Streaming, TimescaleDB, Tiger Data.
  • GenAI: LangGraph, LangChain, LiteLLM, Azure OpenAI/Anthropic/Local SLMs.
  • Graph/Data: Neo4j (Cypher), PostgreSQL (pg_vector, Full-Text Search).

Desired Profile

  • Problem Solver: You dig into logs to find the root cause of a data spike, a silent failure, or a disconnected node in a graph.

description:
About TTC

The Testing Consultancy (TTC) is a global specialist software testing company with a focus on helping organizations transform the way they deliver quality software. We have broad capabilities across a wide range of testing areas including SAP testing and TOSCA automation that enable our clients to increase the speed and quality of software development while reducing risk and cost.

Perks of working for TTC

  • Open to C2C
  • Competitive Base Salary
  • Work Life Balance
  • Relaxed Work Environment
  • Growth and Development Opportunities

Summary

The primary purpose of the Bilingual SAP Tosca Consultant role is to lead and deliver SAP testing and TOSCA automation services to customers using industry standards and best practices to meet TTC customer requirements. The Bilingual SAP Tosca Consultant will work collaboratively to build and establish the overall QA process with a focus on SAP landscapes and model based test automation through TOSCA. Responsibilities for this position also include mentoring QA personnel on SAP testing methodology, TOSCA frameworks, automation strategies, and other technical aspects. The Bilingual SAP Tosca Consultant may also assist in general application support of SAP production applications and systems, managing relationships with business owners, software vendors, auditors, and internal IT teams.

The ideal candidate will have strong SAP functional knowledge, deep hands on experience with TOSCA automation, and the ability to lead both functional and technical discussions. They must be proactive, strategic, technically strong, and capable of performing hands on work as required.

Responsibilities

  • Consult with the customer on the design and implementation of comprehensive Test Activities across SAP modules and TOSCA automation that satisfy Test Objectives and ensure sustainable product Quality throughout the SDLC
  • Advise on all aspects of QA including SAP specific best practices, establishing metrics, applying leading TOSCA automation strategies, and developing tools and processes to meet quality goals
  • Develop, plan, execute, and maintain SAP test cases, TOSCA scripts, plans, and protocols for solutions under development
  • Participate in the deployment of SAP enhancements, upgrades, integrations, and major implementations
  • Complete User Acceptance Testing to validate the end to end business flow across SAP modules
  • Identify opportunities for SAP test process optimization and TOSCA framework improvements with a focus on continuous improvement and customer value
  • Establish and evolve formal QA processes for SAP projects ensuring that the team is using best practices and scalable TOSCA automation approaches
  • Act as a key point of contact for all QA aspects of SAP releases and TOSCA automation delivery while managing customer expectations
  • Work with project management to meet SAP testing milestones and deliver high quality automated and manual testing solutions on time
  • Lead, collaborate, and mentor QA team members on SAP testing methods and TOSCA automation best practices while sharing domain knowledge to expand team capabilities

Technical Skills

  • Hands on experience with TOSCA automation including modules, test case design, execution, and automation framework development
  • Strong knowledge of SAP modules such as FIORI, MM, PM, SD, FICO, PP and QM, BW, EWM, BPC, APO, or others
  • Experience automating SAP applications using TOSCA including navigation, test case recording, and building reusable automation assets
  • Excellent verbal and written communication with the ability to explain SAP and TOSCA technical concepts to internal and external stakeholders
  • Leadership skills with the ability to mentor QA professionals in SAP testing and TOSCA automation
  • Ability to work independently, meet SAP project timelines, and adapt to changing requirements
  • Experience with SDLC including SAP business planning, data analysis, functional requirements analysis, and application design
  • Strong decision making and problem-solving skills related to SAP functional and TOSCA automation challenges
  • Ability to evaluate information from multiple SAP sources, assess risks, prioritize user needs, and design appropriate test solutions
  • Experience working in Agile and Waterfall development environments
  • Knowledge of large-scale SAP deployments, implementations, support, and upgrade projects

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Information Systems, or Computer Science
  • 7+ years of experience in Software Development and Quality Assurance including User Acceptance Testing, Functional Testing, Performance Testing, Manual and Automated Testing. UAT experience is required
  • 3-6 years of SAP Functional Testing experience
  • 2-4 years of hands-on TOSCA automation experience
  • ISTQB Certification preferred

If your experience or qualifications are similar to our ideal candidate, please consider applying. Experience comes in many forms, skills may be transferable, but passion for your career cannot be substituted. At TTC, we recognize the value of diversity and the unique perspectives it brings. We encourage everyone to apply.
